Vascon Engineers Wins ₹660.79 Crore Order from Qualcomm

Vascon Engineers has secured a contract worth ₹660.79 crore from Qualcomm for a project involving their Bengaluru office. Following the announcement, Vascon Engineers' shares experienced a significant increase, zooming by 14%.
